blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.en: Understand the reporting requirements and regulatory basis for postapproval packaging changes

blocks.en: Understand the special considerations for bulk drug substance and bulk drug product containers

blocks.zh: IV. Postapproval Packaging Changes 核准後包裝變更
blocks.en: IV. Postapproval Packaging Changes

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Postapproval Change (核准後變更): 對已核准申請案中的 CCS、其組件、材料組成、或相關製程的任何變更。所有變更都必須向 FDA 申報。
blocks.en: Postapproval change: Any change to the CCS, its components, material composition or related processes in an approved application. All changes must be reported to FDA.

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 314.70: 規範 NDA/ANDA 的 supplements (補件) 與 changes (變更) 之申報要求。
blocks.en: 21 CFR 314.70: Governs the reporting requirements for supplements and changes to an NDA/ANDA.

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 601.12: 規範 BLA (生物製品許可申請) 之核准後變更申報要求。
blocks.en: 21 CFR 601.12: Governs the reporting requirements for postapproval changes to a BLA (Biologics License Application).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把已核准的包裝系統想像成一份建築許可證——一旦核准，任何結構變更（換材料、改設計、調製程）都必須回去向建管處報備。不能自行更換水管材質卻不通報，因為這可能影響整棟建築的安全。同理，包裝的任何變更都可能影響藥品的品質和安全性。
blocks.en: Think of an approved packaging system as a building permit: once approved, any structural change (changing materials, altering the design, adjusting the process) must be reported back to the building authority. You cannot swap the plumbing material without notifying them, because it could affect the safety of the whole building. Likewise, any change to packaging could affect the quality and safety of the drug product.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: FDA 明確表示「任何」等級的 CCS 變更都須申報——從整個系統到單一組件再到材料組成，無一例外。這包括看似「微小」的變更，如更換供應商（即使規格相同）、調整製程條件（如不同的固化溫度），甚至更換脫模劑。
blocks.en: FDA states explicitly that a CCS change at "any" level must be reported, from the whole system to a single component to the material composition, without exception. This includes seemingly "minor" changes such as changing suppliers (even with identical specifications), adjusting process conditions (such as a different curing temperature), or even changing the mold release agent.

blocks.zh: 送審內容應涵蓋 Section III.B (suitability — protection, compatibility, safety, performance) 和 III.C (description, suitability data, QC, stability) 的所有相關項目。
blocks.en: The submission should cover all relevant items of Section III.B (suitability: protection, compatibility, safety, performance) and III.C (description, suitability data, QC, stability).

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 在協助客戶管理包裝供應鏈時，必須建立完善的變更管控程序。當包裝材料供應商通知配方或製程變更時，應：(1) 評估變更是否影響 protection、safety、compatibility 或 performance；(2) 確定適用的 supplement 類別 (Prior Approval, CBE-30, 或 Annual Report)；(3) 準備相應的數據包支持變更申報。SUPAC-IR/MR guidance 可作為劑型特定的變更評估參考。
blocks.en: When helping clients manage the packaging supply chain, a CDMO must establish a sound change control procedure. When a packaging material supplier notifies a formulation or process change, the CDMO should: (1) assess whether the change affects protection, safety, compatibility or performance; (2) determine the applicable supplement category (Prior Approval, CBE-30 or Annual Report); (3) prepare the corresponding data package to support the change filing. The SUPAC-IR/MR guidance can serve as a dosage-form-specific reference for change assessment.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 若 elastomeric stopper 的供應商在不更改配方的情況下更換了製造設備，這是否需要向 FDA 申報？依據是什麼？
blocks.en: If the supplier of an elastomeric stopper changes manufacturing equipment without changing the formulation, does this need to be reported to FDA? On what basis?

blocks.zh: NDA/ANDA (21 CFR 314.70) 和 BLA (21 CFR 601.12) 的包裝變更申報要求有何主要差異？
blocks.en: What are the main differences in packaging change reporting requirements between an NDA/ANDA (21 CFR 314.70) and a BLA (21 CFR 601.12)?

blocks.zh: V. Type III Drug Master Files 第三類藥品主檔案
blocks.en: V. Type III Drug Master Files

blocks.zh: Type III DMF (第三類藥品主檔案): 專用於 Packaging Materials 的 DMF 類型。允許包裝材料製造商將專有資訊提交給 FDA，而無需直接透露給藥品 applicant。
blocks.en: Type III DMF: The DMF type dedicated to packaging materials. It allows packaging material manufacturers to submit proprietary information to FDA without disclosing it directly to the drug applicant.

blocks.zh: Letter of Authorization, LOA (授權信): DMF 持有者發給 applicant 的正式信函，須載明：(1) 被授權的公司；(2) 所涉組件或材料；(3) 資料在 DMF 中的位置（頁碼/提交日期）。
blocks.en: Letter of Authorization (LOA): A formal letter from the DMF holder to the applicant, which must state: (1) the authorized company; (2) the components or materials concerned; (3) the location of the information in the DMF (page number/submission date).

blocks.zh: Type III DMF 就像銀行的保險箱——包裝材料供應商把配方機密鎖在裡面，發給客戶一把「授權鑰匙」(LOA)。FDA 審查員只在審查特定申請案時才打開查看。這樣既保護了商業秘密，又讓 FDA 能獲取做出核准決定所需的完整資訊。
blocks.en: A Type III DMF is like a bank safe deposit box: the packaging material supplier locks its confidential formulation inside and gives the customer an "authorization key" (LOA). The FDA reviewer opens it only when reviewing a specific application. This protects trade secrets while still giving FDA the complete information it needs to make an approval decision.

blocks.zh: DMF 變更通知義務 (21 CFR 314.420(c)): DMF 持有者必須在實施變更前「充分提前」通知所有受影響的 applicant。這點對 CDMO 極為重要——若您的包裝材料供應商更新了 DMF 內容，您必須及時收到通知並評估是否需要向自己的客戶和相關申請案報告。
blocks.en: DMF change notification obligation (21 CFR 314.420(c)): The DMF holder must notify all affected applicants "well in advance" of implementing a change. This is extremely important for a CDMO: if your packaging material supplier updates the DMF content, you must receive timely notice and assess whether it needs to be reported to your own clients and the relevant applications.

blocks.zh: FDA 通常只在審查特定申請案時才審閱 DMF。DMF 本身不會被獨立「核准」——它只是支持性文件的存放機制。
blocks.en: FDA usually reviews a DMF only when reviewing a specific application. A DMF is not "approved" on its own; it is simply a repository for supporting documents.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的供應商管理程序應包含：(1) 建立所有引用 DMF 的清單；(2) 與 DMF 持有者簽訂品質協議 (Quality Agreement)，明確變更通知義務和時程；(3) 定期確認 LOA 的有效性和資訊定位的準確性；(4) 當 DMF 內容變更時，評估對所有受影響產品的影響並通知客戶。
blocks.en: A CDMO's supplier management procedure should include: (1) maintaining a list of all referenced DMFs; (2) signing a Quality Agreement with the DMF holder that clearly defines change notification obligations and timelines; (3) periodically confirming the validity of the LOA and the accuracy of the information locations; (4) when DMF content changes, assessing the impact on all affected products and notifying clients.

blocks.zh: 如果包裝材料供應商沒有 DMF，CDMO 要如何在保護供應商配方機密的同時滿足 FDA 的審查需求？
blocks.en: If a packaging material supplier has no DMF, how can a CDMO meet FDA's review needs while protecting the supplier's confidential formulation?

blocks.zh: LOA 中為什麼要精確標示「資料在 DMF 中的位置」？這對含有多組件資訊的 DMF 有何特別重要性？
blocks.en: Why must an LOA state precisely "the location of the information in the DMF"? Why is this especially important for a DMF containing information on multiple components?

blocks.zh: V.B. Information in a Type III DMF — DMF 內容範例
blocks.en: V.B. Information in a Type III DMF: Examples of DMF Content

blocks.zh: DMF 三大內容區塊:
blocks.en: The three main content blocks of a DMF:

blocks.zh: 1. Descriptive (描述性資訊): 組件描述、製造廠址、製程、後處理、放行管控
blocks.en: 1. Descriptive information: Component description, manufacturing sites, manufacturing process, post-processing, release controls.

blocks.zh: 2. Suitability (適用性資訊): 保護功能、安全性、相容性
blocks.en: 2. Suitability information: Protection function, safety, compatibility.

blocks.zh: 3. Quality Control (品管資訊): 尺寸規格 (工程圖)、性能標準、組成一致性監控
blocks.en: 3. Quality Control information: Dimensional specifications (engineering drawings), performance standards, monitoring of composition consistency.

blocks.zh: DMF 的內容就像汽車零件的技術規格書——告訴你零件長什麼樣 (descriptive)、能承受什麼環境 (suitability)、以及如何確保每批零件都一樣好 (QC)。沒有這份技術規格書，整車廠（applicant）就無法向監理機關證明車輛安全。
blocks.en: The content of a DMF is like the technical datasheet for a car part: it tells you what the part looks like (descriptive), what environment it can withstand (suitability) and how to ensure every batch of parts is equally good (QC). Without this datasheet, the car maker (the applicant) cannot demonstrate to the regulator that the vehicle is safe.

blocks.zh: 注意 DMF 中的 compatibility 資訊可以是針對「specific drug product」或「equivalent materials」。這意味著供應商可以用等效材料的相容性數據來支持不同客戶的申請案——但最終是否被接受取決於 FDA 審查員的判斷。
blocks.en: Note that compatibility information in a DMF can be for the "specific drug product" or for "equivalent materials". This means a supplier can use compatibility data from equivalent materials to support different customers' applications, but whether it is finally accepted depends on the judgment of the FDA reviewer.

blocks.zh: Statistical Process Control (SPC) 在此特別被提及——若包裝組件的放行是基於 SPC 而非傳統的批次測試，則須提供完整的製程描述和驗證資訊。
blocks.en: Statistical Process Control (SPC) is specifically mentioned here: if release of packaging components is based on SPC rather than conventional batch testing, a complete process description and validation information must be provided.

blocks.zh: DMF 中的 engineering drawing 包含 target dimensions 和 tolerances。為什麼尺寸公差對注射劑 vial-stopper 系統的密封完整性至關重要？
blocks.en: The engineering drawing in a DMF contains target dimensions and tolerances. Why are dimensional tolerances critical to the seal integrity of an injectable vial-stopper system?

blocks.zh: 如果您是 elastomeric stopper 製造商，您會在 DMF 中放入哪些 suitability 數據？如果客戶產品是高 pH 蛋白質製劑，還需要額外提供什麼？
blocks.en: If you were an elastomeric stopper manufacturer, what suitability data would you include in the DMF? If the customer's product is a high-pH protein formulation, what additional data would be needed?

blocks.zh: VI. Bulk Containers 大量容器
blocks.en: VI. Bulk Containers

blocks.zh: Bulk Drug Substance Container (原料藥大量容器): 用於儲存或運輸原料藥的容器系統。固體通常為 drum + double LDPE liners；液體通常為不鏽鋼、玻璃內襯金屬容器或塑膠容器。
blocks.en: Bulk Drug Substance Container: A container system used to store or ship drug substance. For solids this is usually a drum with double LDPE liners; for liquids it is usually stainless steel, glass-lined metal or plastic containers.

blocks.zh: Retest Period (複驗期): 原料藥在指定容器中的穩定期限，到期後需重新檢測才能使用。穩定性試驗須在 desiccant 到位的情況下進行。
blocks.en: Retest Period: The period during which the drug substance remains stable in the specified container, after which it must be retested before use. Stability studies must be conducted with the desiccant in place.

blocks.zh: Bulk drug substance 的包裝就像食材的倉儲方式——乾貨 (固體) 用大桶加內袋密封；醬料 (液體) 用不鏽鋼桶。LDPE 內袋對濕氣的阻隔就像普通塑膠袋裝餅乾——能擋一時，但長期儲存需要鋁箔積層袋。穩定性試驗就像測試食材在特定包裝中能放多久不變質。
blocks.en: Packaging of bulk drug substance is like the storage of food ingredients: dry goods (solids) go in large drums with sealed inner bags; sauces (liquids) go in stainless steel drums. The moisture barrier of an LDPE inner bag is like an ordinary plastic bag for biscuits: it holds up for a while, but long-term storage needs a laminated foil bag. A stability study is like testing how long an ingredient keeps in a given package without spoiling.

blocks.zh: LDPE 的水蒸氣透過率 (WVTR) 相對較高——對濕敏感的原料藥（如許多 lyophilized 產品的 API），LDPE bag 可能不足以提供充分保護。此時應考慮使用 laminate bag (通常含 aluminum foil barrier layer)。
blocks.en: LDPE has a relatively high water vapor transmission rate (WVTR). For moisture-sensitive drug substances (such as the API of many lyophilized products), an LDPE bag may not provide sufficient protection. In this case, consider a laminate bag (usually with an aluminum foil barrier layer).

blocks.zh: 穩定性試驗可使用「模擬實際 CCS 的較小版本」——這是務實的做法，因為以實際大桶 (如 200L drum) 進行穩定性試驗在實務上極不方便。但模擬版本必須能代表實際系統的保護特性。
blocks.en: Stability studies may use "a smaller version simulating the actual CCS". This is a pragmatic approach, because running stability studies in the actual large drum (such as a 200 L drum) is very inconvenient in practice. However, the simulated version must be representative of the protective properties of the actual system.

blocks.zh: CDMO 在接收客戶 API 時，應驗證：(1) 運輸容器的 CCS 描述是否與 DMF/申請案中的記載一致；(2) desiccant 是否到位且有效；(3) 是否在 retest period 內。若發現容器類型不符或已超過 retest period，應啟動偏差調查並通知客戶。
blocks.en: When receiving a client's API, a CDMO should verify: (1) that the CCS description of the shipping container matches what is recorded in the DMF/application; (2) that the desiccant is in place and effective; (3) that the material is within its retest period. If the container type does not match or the retest period has been exceeded, a deviation investigation should be initiated and the client notified.

blocks.zh: 為什麼穩定性試驗要求在 desiccant 到位的情況下進行？如果不放 desiccant 做試驗，結果會如何影響 retest period 的設定？
blocks.en: Why must stability studies be conducted with the desiccant in place? If a study is run without desiccant, how would the results affect the setting of the retest period?

blocks.zh: CDMO 在評估客戶 API 的 bulk container 時，應關注哪些保護因素？請列出至少五項。
blocks.en: When assessing the bulk container of a client's API, what protection factors should a CDMO focus on? List at least five.

blocks.zh: On-site Storage Container (廠內儲存容器): 一般歸類為 CGMP 議題 (21 CFR 211.65)，但若計劃長期儲存，須在申請案中描述 CCS 和最長儲存時間，並提供穩定性數據。
blocks.en: On-site Storage Container: Generally treated as a CGMP issue (21 CFR 211.65), but if long-term storage is planned, the CCS and the maximum storage time must be described in the application and supported by stability data.

blocks.zh: Large-Volume Shipping Package → Market Package: 關鍵概念——當大量包裝用於運送藥品至 repackager 銷售時，FDA 將其視為 market package，需符合與小型市售包裝相同的所有要求。
blocks.en: Large-Volume Shipping Package → Market Package: A key concept: when a bulk package is used to ship drug product to a repackager for sale, FDA treats it as a market package, which must meet all the same requirements as a small marketed package.

blocks.zh: 廠內的 bulk holding tank 就像餐廳廚房裡的暫存容器——短期存放是日常操作（CGMP 管控），但如果你要存放好幾天，就要確保容器材質不會與食物反應，且能維持溫度和衛生。而大桶裝出貨給零售藥局的 10,000 顆藥錠桶，則等同於上架的商品包裝——必須通過和小瓶裝完全相同的品質和穩定性標準。
blocks.en: An on-site bulk holding tank is like a temporary container in a restaurant kitchen: short-term holding is routine operation (controlled under CGMP), but if you will hold the food for several days, you must make sure the container material does not react with the food and can maintain temperature and hygiene. A drum of 10,000 tablets shipped to a retail pharmacy, by contrast, is equivalent to the packaging of a shelf product and must meet exactly the same quality and stability standards as a small bottle.

blocks.zh: 極重要區分：bulk drug product 運送至 contract packager 的容器只需描述在申請案中即可；但運送至 repackager 的大量容器被視為 market package，須納入穩定性試驗計畫和長期穩定性 protocol。這兩者的法規要求層級完全不同。
blocks.en: A critical distinction: For bulk drug product shipped to a contract packager, the container only needs to be described in the application; but a bulk container shipped to a repackager is treated as a market package and must be included in the stability testing program and the long-term stability protocol. The regulatory requirements for the two are at completely different levels.

blocks.zh: 即使是短期儲存，仍須使用具有adequate protection、compatible 且 safe 的 CCS。「短期」不是降低標準的理由。
blocks.en: Even for short-term storage, a CCS that provides adequate protection and is compatible and safe must still be used. "Short-term" is not a reason to lower the standard.

blocks.zh: CDMO 常見情境：完成無菌充填後，成品可能需要暫存於 bulk container 中等待貼標和二次包裝。此時須：(1) 在 BPR/申請案中定義 bulk holding CCS 和最長 holding time；(2) 用穩定性數據支持 holding time；(3) 確保 holding container 的材料相容性已驗證。若 CDMO 同時作為 contract packager 接收客戶的 bulk product，則運輸容器也須被納入管控範圍。
blocks.en: A common CDMO scenario: after sterile filling, the finished product may need to be held temporarily in a bulk container awaiting labeling and secondary packaging. In this case: (1) define the bulk holding CCS and the maximum holding time in the BPR/application; (2) support the holding time with stability data; (3) ensure the material compatibility of the holding container has been validated. If the CDMO also acts as a contract packager receiving a client's bulk product, the shipping container must also be brought within the scope of control.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 FDA 將運送至 repackager 的大量容器視為 market package，而非 contract packager 的運輸容器？這背後的病人安全邏輯是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does FDA treat a bulk container shipped to a repackager as a market package, rather than as a contract packager's shipping container? What is the patient safety logic behind this?

blocks.zh: CDMO 的 bulk holding time validation 應涵蓋哪些測試項目？請結合無菌注射劑的特性回答。
blocks.en: What test items should a CDMO's bulk holding time validation cover? Answer with reference to the characteristics of sterile injectables.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 核准後任何 CCS 變更（系統、組件、材料、製程）皆須依 21 CFR 314.70 (NDA/ANDA) 或 21 CFR 601.12 (BLA) 申報
blocks.en: Any postapproval CCS change (system, component, material, process) must be reported under 21 CFR 314.70 (NDA/ANDA) or 21 CFR 601.12 (BLA).

blocks.zh: Type III DMF 是保護包裝材料專有資訊的機制，FDA 僅在審查特定申請案時審閱；LOA 須精確指定授權範圍和資料位置
blocks.en: A Type III DMF is a mechanism for protecting proprietary information on packaging materials; FDA reviews it only when reviewing a specific application; the LOA must specify precisely the scope of authorization and the location of the information.

blocks.zh: DMF 持有者有義務在變更實施前通知所有受影響的 applicant (21 CFR 314.420(c))
blocks.en: DMF holders are obliged to notify all affected applicants before a change is implemented (21 CFR 314.420(c)).

blocks.zh: Bulk drug substance 容器：固體用 drum + LDPE liners，液體用 stainless steel / glass-lined container；穩定性試驗可用模擬版本
blocks.en: Bulk drug substance containers: drum + LDPE liners for solids, stainless steel / glass-lined containers for liquids; stability studies may use a simulated version.

blocks.zh: Bulk drug product 容器：on-site storage 為 CGMP 議題但須有穩定性支持；運送至 repackager 的大量容器被視為 market package，法規要求最高
blocks.en: Bulk drug product containers: on-site storage is a CGMP issue but must be supported by stability data; a bulk container shipped to a repackager is treated as a market package, with the highest regulatory requirements.
